utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I’m happy to check in while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — that would be helpful. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll keep an eye out for the next update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep asking around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need me to fix for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you check the porch light and the loose gate latch? Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll check the porch light and the gate latch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, the repair drive—just to confirm, that’s still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the timing and pickup details first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—just let me know once you’ve confirmed the time and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I can help, I just need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — we still need a few basics: tape, screws, and one sturdy screwdriver. If you can bring any of that, I’ll keep a list and sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can bring the screwdriver for sure, and maybe some screws if I can find them. I’ll check my toolbox and swing by soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it starts at 10, and bringing a screwdriver or tape would be helpful. Sorry, I’m a bit fuzzy on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — starts at 10, and I’ll bring a screwdriver or tape. If you remember anything else, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — I heard about the repair drive and wanted to see how I can help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all — glad you made it! We could really use another hand sorting tools and checking in with folks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I can start sorting tools and help check people in. Just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Gus. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donated tools and set aside anything we can lend out? I’ll bring by the labels and a couple bins.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Gus — I’ll sort the donated tools and set aside the ones we can lend out. Bring the labels and bins whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to keep track of it—where’s the repair drive happening, and what time should I note?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s happening at the community center gym, and I’ll note it for Saturday morning at 10.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note the community center gym for Saturday morning at 10.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I’ve been hearing a few folks mention it around the block—if you want, I can pass along what I know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess! Please do—if you’ve got the details, I’ll help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the full details yet, but I’ll keep my ear out and let you know as soon as I hear more. If you spot any flyers or updates, send them my way and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Rey — is the repair drive still happening this weekend, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Mina — yes, it’s still on this weekend. If you can bring a screwdriver set and some extra screws, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and some extra screws.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s make a quick plan and see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces, so a quick plan would really help. What do you want to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Let’s start with the biggest repairs first, then make a simple list of what still needs tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m lining up the repair drive now. If you’re available, I’d love your help with the sign-up sheet and a quick door-to-door check-in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the sign-up sheet. I’m a bit quiet for the door-to-door part, but I can do a few houses.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Uli — thank you. I’ll handle the door-to-door route, and you can take the sign-up sheet and a few nearby houses.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks are already dropping off tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. I’ll stop by with my old wrench set this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Eli — I’m sure they’ll be glad to have it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what kind of repairs still need doing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we still need a few folks for basic patching, hauling, and tool setup. I’ll round up a couple neighbors and repeat the plan so everyone knows what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I can help with the tool setup or hauling if you still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that. I’m still sorting a few things out, but I can tell you what’s left for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’m listening—what’s left on the list?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in — just send me the basics for the repair drive and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is at the community center parking lot on Maple, Saturday morning from 9 to 11. We’re collecting tools, sealant, and any spare bike parts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Maple community center parking lot, Saturday 9 to 11. I’ll keep an eye out for tools, sealant, and bike parts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge the groups for the repair drive—just let me know who you want me to reach out to.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you reach out to the groups that signed up last week and ask who can bring tools or supplies? If you can, please confirm back by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to the groups that signed up last week and ask who can bring tools or supplies, then confirm back by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What did you need me to check?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you check whether the tool table is set up and if we still need any extension cords?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can check the tool table, but I might miss the cords if they’ve been moved again. I’ll take a look now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate it, Ira — if you spot anyone needing a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll let you know if I hear of anyone who could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the tool list and bring it by Friday—just need a quick headcount first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I can help with the headcount if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and where everything will be dropped off. Do we know the exact plan yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet—I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off details. I’ll check and let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mina — I appreciate it. Once you have the drop-off details, could you let me know the timing too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or bring you the details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please put my name down and bring me the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll put your name down and drop by with the details soon. Glad to have you join us!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just remind me what’s needed, and I’ll do my best to get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — we mostly need small household repairs, tools, and any spare parts people can donate. If you can spread the word, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sounds good, Nell — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep folks updated.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and let folks know too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Nell — I’ll send out the details and next steps as soon as I have them.
